answer: A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the vine graph. Re-attestations are stored in grove and umber lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 4 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 629 impostors cost 330 times the honest price and take 15 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
